interpretation_rules: Original downloaded bytes, votes and literal comments are authoritative; this record is a human-readable triage, not a changed vote.
Overall rejection overrides art-pool approvals. Discussion comments can redirect a proposal without approving its original class/room.
No preferred cells or priorities were selected. No selected-actor conflicts does not establish a final collision-free assignment.
Monochrome derivatives are allowed for approved art/gaps; preserve original PNG bytes, nearest sampling and alpha. This changes the earlier standalone-only-source assumption.
Excluded cells are excluded for their specified proposal; do not infer a global ban on a sprite explicitly approved elsewhere.
Preserve every existing rejection and the two held groups. Do not restart the rejected generic art-pool proposals as hidden features.
No gameplay, rendering, save or source PNG changes are part of receiving this feedback.

clarifications.rule: Skull may instantly kill ordinary regular enemies only. Minibosses and the final boss are exempt; a special encounter is not implicitly a regular enemy.
